scope: Accept P06-A02 for the bounded RV64 p02-tfr optimization suite through commit 786f0ee43fbc4a5153c82c66baef98eaef2c372f: (1) SimX Core-scoped TraceOwner RAII ownership (8a38d88), (2) TCU mx_scale_at localparam shift fix eliminating the +16 DSP regression (1cf68ff), and (3) single-launch 4-warp fused native Tiny-MLP kernel ai_mlp_fused (786f0ee) reducing launches from 3 to 1 (3.0x), logical H2D+D2H traffic from 2,688 B to 1,344 B (2.0x), and active cycles from 18,189 SimX baseline cycles to 9,913 (-n 2) / 10,130 (-n 1) simx (~1.80x-1.83x SimX speedup) and 10,078 rtlsim (~1.80x vs SimX baseline) for BF16 seeded_dense, and 12,628 simx (1.44x SimX speedup) / 12,573 rtlsim (1.45x vs SimX baseline, 0-instr delta, 0.44% cycle parity) for FP16 seeded_dense with zero numerical mismatches across all 320 FP32 logits, 640 FP32 hidden words (-v), and 320 bridge words (-v). All P02/P03/P04/P06-A01 numerical contracts and baselines are preserved untouched.
configuration: build64_p02tfr configured via ../configure --xlen=64 --profile=p02-tfr (profiles/p02-tfr.json: 1 cluster, 1 core, 4 warps, 4 threads, issue width 1, native TFR TCU, USE_DSP=0, STD FPU, LMEM enabled); verified on both SimX timing model and native processor RTL (rtlsim) in FP16 (-DKUNROLL=1, --args='-n 2 -v') and BF16 (-DKUNROLL=1, --args='-n 2' on SimX and default args on rtlsim) modes.
limitations: Acceptance covers P06-A02 at rtl_verified evidence level on SimX and native processor RTL (rtlsim) under RV64 p02-tfr; it does not establish physical FPGA performance, XRT hw_emu, or silicon execution.

P06-A01 baseline (18,189 active core cycles) is SimX-only (simulated); SimX-to-SimX comparisons are 18,189 -> 9,913 (-n 2) / 10,130 (-n 1) for BF16 and 18,189 -> 12,628 for FP16, while rtlsim establishes native processor RTL parity (10,078 BF16 / 12,573 FP16).

Local p06_qualified_warm execution remains externally blocked because the owner-retained private control archive d3a16e1e6e92a68414f5fdcce564b963dde2e9e801601191d52ceeb974faea6f was not supplied; that block is preserved without waiver.
P01-A03 vendor XRT hw_emu remains blocked and is required before P07 can close; P07-P11 remain not_started pending physical Alveo U55C/V80 FPGA hardware and human approval/funding.
Logical H2D+D2H transfer bytes (1,344 B vs 2,688 B) measure explicit tensor buffer traffic and exclude command/argument staging and physical PCIe/HBM DMA overhead.
reviewer: Independent Neon R2 review completed on 8a38d88 (TraceOwner RAII), 1cf68ff (TCU mx_scale_at localparam shift fix), and 786f0ee (ai_mlp_fused, all 4 F2 + 2 F1 findings resolved and re-verified on SimX -n 2 -v and rtlsim); P06-A02 closure record prepared by Gemini Hydrogen implementer.
